mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_attack_archive (station_id, event_kind, event_name, location, mode, started_at, finished_at, person_count, person_snapshot_json, created_by) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{eventKind}, #{eventName}, #{location}, #{mode}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{personCount}, #{personSnapshotJson}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE ccds_attack_archive SET event_kind = #{eventKind}, event_name = #{eventName}, location = #{location}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, station_id, event_kind, event_name, location, mode, started_at, finished_at, person_count, person_snapshot_json, created_by, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_attack_archive WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, station_id, event_kind, event_name, location, mode, started_at, finished_at, person_count, person_snapshot_json, created_by, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_attack_archive WHERE station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC
